topic: What is the bag size limit at the Emirates Stadium?

text: Does anyone know the bag size limit at the emirates 🤔

@claude what's the bag size limit at the Emirates Stadium?

Arsenal's guidance says to avoid bringing a bag if you can. Bags larger than A4 aren't allowed, and all bags get searched. One third-party guide says A5 or a clear bag, but I couldn't confirm that. I only saw search results, not the official page, so check before you go: https://www.arsenal.com/matchday-safety-and-security
